gastrodon.flavor_text: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.

ambipom.name: Ambipom
ambipom.evolution_method: on level up while knowing Double Hit
ambipom.flavor_text: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

drifloon.name: Drifloon
drifloon.flavor_text: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

drifblim.name: Drifblim
drifblim.flavor_text: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

buneary.name: Buneary
buneary.flavor_text: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

lopunny.name: Lopunny
lopunny.evolution_method: on level up with high friendship
lopunny.flavor_text: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

mismagius.name: Mismagius
mismagius.flavor_text: The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.

honchkrow.name: Honchkrow
honchkrow.flavor_text: One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.

glameow.name: Glameow
glameow.flavor_text: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

purugly.name: Purugly
purugly.flavor_text: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.

chingling.name: Chingling
chingling.flavor_text: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

stunky.name: Stunky
stunky.flavor_text: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.

skuntank.name: Skuntank
skuntank.flavor_text: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.

bronzor.name: Bronzor
bronzor.flavor_text: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

bronzong.name: Bronzong
bronzong.flavor_text: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

bonsly.name: Bonsly
bonsly.flavor_text: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.

mime-jr.name: Mime Jr.
mime-jr.flavor_text: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

happiny.name: Happiny
happiny.flavor_text: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

chatot.name: Chatot
chatot.flavor_text: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

spiritomb.name: Spiritomb
spiritomb.flavor_text: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

gible.name: Gible
gible.flavor_text: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

gabite.name: Gabite
gabite.flavor_text: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

garchomp.name: Garchomp
garchomp.flavor_text: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

munchlax.name: Munchlax
munchlax.flavor_text: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

riolu.name: Riolu
riolu.flavor_text: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

lucario.name: Lucario
lucario.evolution_method: on level up with high friendship during the day
lucario.flavor_text: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

hippopotas.name: Hippopotas
hippopotas.flavor_text: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

hippowdon.name: Hippowdon
hippowdon.flavor_text: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

skorupi.name: Skorupi
skorupi.flavor_text: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

drapion.name: Drapion
drapion.flavor_text: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

croagunk.name: Croagunk
croagunk.flavor_text: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

toxicroak.name: Toxicroak
toxicroak.flavor_text: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

carnivine.name: Carnivine
carnivine.flavor_text: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

finneon.name: Finneon
finneon.flavor_text: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

lumineon.name: Lumineon
lumineon.flavor_text: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

mantyke.name: Mantyke
mantyke.flavor_text: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

snover.name: Snover
snover.flavor_text: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

abomasnow.name: Abomasnow
abomasnow.flavor_text: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

weavile.name: Weavile
weavile.evolution_method: on level up while holding a Razor Claw during the night
weavile.flavor_text: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

magnezone.name: Magnezone
magnezone.flavor_text: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

lickilicky.name: Lickilicky
lickilicky.evolution_method: on level up while knowing Rollout
lickilicky.flavor_text: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

rhyperior.name: Rhyperior
rhyperior.evolution_method: when traded while holding a Protector
rhyperior.flavor_text: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

tangrowth.name: Tangrowth
tangrowth.evolution_method: on level up while knowing Ancient Power
tangrowth.flavor_text: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

electivire.name: Electivire
electivire.evolution_method: when traded while holding an Electirizer
electivire.flavor_text: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

magmortar.name: Magmortar
magmortar.evolution_method: when traded while holding a Magmarizer
magmortar.flavor_text: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

togekiss.name: Togekiss
togekiss.flavor_text: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

yanmega.name: Yanmega
yanmega.evolution_method: on level up while knowing Ancient Power
yanmega.flavor_text: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

leafeon.name: Leafeon
leafeon.flavor_text: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

glaceon.name: Glaceon
glaceon.flavor_text: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

gliscor.name: Gliscor
gliscor.evolution_method: on level up while holding a Razor Fang during the night
gliscor.flavor_text: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

mamoswine.name: Mamoswine
mamoswine.evolution_method: on level up while knowing Ancient Power
mamoswine.flavor_text: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

porygon-z.name: Porygon-Z
porygon-z.evolution_method: when traded while holding a Dubious Disc
porygon-z.flavor_text: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

gallade.name: Gallade
gallade.flavor_text: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

probopass.name: Probopass
probopass.flavor_text: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

dusknoir.name: Dusknoir
dusknoir.evolution_method: when traded while holding a Reaper Cloth
dusknoir.flavor_text: Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.

froslass.name: Froslass
froslass.flavor_text: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

rotom.name: Rotom
rotom.flavor_text: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

uxie.name: Uxie
uxie.flavor_text: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.

mesprit.name: Mesprit
mesprit.flavor_text: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

azelf.name: Azelf
azelf.flavor_text: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

dialga.name: Dialga
dialga.flavor_text: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

palkia.name: Palkia
palkia.flavor_text: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

heatran.name: Heatran
heatran.flavor_text: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

regigigas.name: Regigigas
regigigas.flavor_text: According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.

giratina.name: Giratina
giratina.flavor_text: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

cresselia.name: Cresselia
cresselia.flavor_text: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

phione.name: Phione
phione.flavor_text: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

manaphy.name: Manaphy
manaphy.flavor_text: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

darkrai.name: Darkrai
darkrai.flavor_text: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

shaymin.name: Shaymin
shaymin.flavor_text: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

arceus.name: Arceus
arceus.flavor_text: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

victini.name: Victini
victini.flavor_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

snivy.name: Snivy
snivy.flavor_text: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

servine.name: Servine
servine.flavor_text: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

serperior.name: Serperior
serperior.flavor_text: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

tepig.name: Tepig
tepig.flavor_text: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

pignite.name: Pignite
pignite.flavor_text: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

emboar.name: Emboar
emboar.flavor_text: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

oshawott.name: Oshawott
oshawott.flavor_text: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

dewott.name: Dewott
dewott.flavor_text: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

samurott.name: Samurott
samurott.flavor_text: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

patrat.name: Patrat
patrat.flavor_text: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.

watchog.name: Watchog
watchog.flavor_text: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

lillipup.name: Lillipup
lillipup.flavor_text: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

herdier.name: Herdier
herdier.flavor_text: The black fur that covers this Pokémon’s body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

stoutland.name: Stoutland
stoutland.flavor_text: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It’s said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.

purrloin.name: Purrloin
purrloin.flavor_text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

liepard.name: Liepard
liepard.flavor_text: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.

pansage.name: Pansage
pansage.flavor_text: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.

simisage.name: Simisage
simisage.flavor_text: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

pansear.name: Pansear
pansear.flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

simisear.name: Simisear
simisear.flavor_text: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

panpour.name: Panpour
panpour.flavor_text: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

simipour.name: Simipour
simipour.flavor_text: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

munna.name: Munna
munna.flavor_text: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it’s eating a good dream, and black when it’s eating a nightmare.

musharna.name: Musharna
musharna.flavor_text: It drowses and dreams all the time. It’s best to leave it be if it’s just woken up, as it’s a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.

pidove.name: Pidove
pidove.flavor_text: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

tranquill.name: Tranquill
tranquill.flavor_text: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

unfezant.name: Unfezant
unfezant.flavor_text: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

blitzle.name: Blitzle
blitzle.flavor_text: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

zebstrika.name: Zebstrika
zebstrika.flavor_text: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

roggenrola.name: Roggenrola
roggenrola.flavor_text: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

boldore.name: Boldore
boldore.flavor_text: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

gigalith.name: Gigalith
gigalith.flavor_text: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

woobat.name: Woobat
woobat.flavor_text: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

swoobat.name: Swoobat
swoobat.evolution_method: on level up with high friendship
swoobat.flavor_text: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

drilbur.name: Drilbur
drilbur.flavor_text: It’s a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

excadrill.name: Excadrill
excadrill.flavor_text: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.

audino.name: Audino
audino.flavor_text: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

timburr.name: Timburr
timburr.flavor_text: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

gurdurr.name: Gurdurr
gurdurr.flavor_text: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

conkeldurr.name: Conkeldurr
conkeldurr.flavor_text: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

tympole.name: Tympole
tympole.flavor_text: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can’t hear its cries of warning.

palpitoad.name: Palpitoad
palpitoad.flavor_text: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

seismitoad.name: Seismitoad
seismitoad.flavor_text: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

throh.name: Throh
throh.flavor_text: They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.

sawk.name: Sawk
sawk.flavor_text: The karate chops of a Sawk that’s trained itself to the limit can cleave the ocean itself.

sewaddle.name: Sewaddle
sewaddle.flavor_text: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.

swadloon.name: Swadloon
swadloon.flavor_text: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

leavanny.name: Leavanny
leavanny.evolution_method: on level up with high friendship
leavanny.flavor_text: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

venipede.name: Venipede
venipede.flavor_text: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.

whirlipede.name: Whirlipede
whirlipede.flavor_text: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.

scolipede.name: Scolipede
scolipede.flavor_text: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

cottonee.name: Cottonee
cottonee.flavor_text: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that’s highly prized by many luxury brands.

whimsicott.name: Whimsicott
whimsicott.flavor_text: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

petilil.name: Petilil
petilil.flavor_text: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

lilligant.name: Lilligant
lilligant.flavor_text: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

basculin.name: Basculin
basculin.flavor_text: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

sandile.name: Sandile
sandile.flavor_text: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

krokorok.name: Krokorok
krokorok.flavor_text: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

krookodile.name: Krookodile
krookodile.flavor_text: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

darumaka.name: Darumaka
darumaka.flavor_text: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.

darmanitan.name: Darmanitan
darmanitan.flavor_text: This Pokémon’s power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

maractus.name: Maractus
maractus.flavor_text: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They’re jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.

dwebble.name: Dwebble
dwebble.flavor_text: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

crustle.name: Crustle
crustle.flavor_text: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They’re mighty enough to crack Rhyperior’s carapace.

scraggy.name: Scraggy
scraggy.flavor_text: It protects itself with its durable skin. It’s thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

scrafty.name: Scrafty
scrafty.flavor_text: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

sigilyph.name: Sigilyph
sigilyph.flavor_text: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.

yamask.name: Yamask
yamask.flavor_text: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

cofagrigus.name: Cofagrigus
cofagrigus.flavor_text: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They’re symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.

tirtouga.name: Tirtouga
tirtouga.flavor_text: Tirtouga is considered to be the ancestor of many turtle Pokémon. It was restored to life from a fossil.

carracosta.name: Carracosta
carracosta.flavor_text: This Pokémon emerges from the water in search of prey despite the fact that it moves more slowly on land.

archen.name: Archen
archen.flavor_text: Archen is said to be the ancestor of bird Pokémon. It lived in treetops, eating berries and bug Pokémon.

archeops.name: Archeops
archeops.flavor_text: Though capable of flight, Archeops was apparently better at hunting on the ground.

trubbish.name: Trubbish
trubbish.flavor_text: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.

garbodor.name: Garbodor
garbodor.flavor_text: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

zorua.name: Zorua
zorua.flavor_text: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

zoroark.name: Zoroark
zoroark.flavor_text: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

minccino.name: Minccino
minccino.flavor_text: They pet each other with their tails as a form of greeting. Of the two, the one whose tail is fluffier is a bit more boastful.

cinccino.name: Cinccino
cinccino.flavor_text: A special oil that seeps through their fur helps them avoid attacks. The oil fetches a high price at market.

gothita.name: Gothita
gothita.flavor_text: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it’s speaking to something only it can see.

gothorita.name: Gothorita
gothorita.flavor_text: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon’s psychic power is at its strongest. It’s unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.

gothitelle.name: Gothitelle
gothitelle.flavor_text: A criminal who was shown his fate by a Gothitelle went missing that same day and was never seen again.

solosis.name: Solosis
solosis.flavor_text: Many say that the special liquid covering this Pokémon’s body would allow it to survive in the vacuum of space.

duosion.name: Duosion
duosion.flavor_text: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

reuniclus.name: Reuniclus
reuniclus.flavor_text: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

ducklett.name: Ducklett
ducklett.flavor_text: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

swanna.name: Swanna
swanna.flavor_text: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

vanillite.name: Vanillite
vanillite.flavor_text: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

vanillish.name: Vanillish
vanillish.flavor_text: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

vanilluxe.name: Vanilluxe
vanilluxe.flavor_text: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

deerling.name: Deerling
deerling.flavor_text: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

sawsbuck.name: Sawsbuck
sawsbuck.flavor_text: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

emolga.name: Emolga
emolga.flavor_text: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

karrablast.name: Karrablast
karrablast.flavor_text: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

escavalier.name: Escavalier
escavalier.flavor_text: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.

foongus.name: Foongus
foongus.flavor_text: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

amoonguss.name: Amoonguss
amoonguss.flavor_text: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

frillish.name: Frillish
frillish.flavor_text: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

jellicent.name: Jellicent
jellicent.flavor_text: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

alomomola.name: Alomomola
alomomola.flavor_text: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.

joltik.name: Joltik
joltik.flavor_text: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.

galvantula.name: Galvantula
galvantula.flavor_text: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

ferroseed.name: Ferroseed
ferroseed.flavor_text: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.

ferrothorn.name: Ferrothorn
ferrothorn.flavor_text: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

klink.name: Klink
klink.flavor_text: It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people’s invention of the first gears.

klang.name: Klang
klang.flavor_text: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.

klinklang.name: Klinklang
klinklang.flavor_text: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t a living creature.

tynamo.name: Tynamo
tynamo.flavor_text: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

eelektrik.name: Eelektrik
eelektrik.flavor_text: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

eelektross.name: Eelektross
eelektross.flavor_text: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

elgyem.name: Elgyem
elgyem.flavor_text: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.

beheeyem.name: Beheeyem
beheeyem.flavor_text: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

litwick.name: Litwick
litwick.flavor_text: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

lampent.name: Lampent
lampent.flavor_text: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

chandelure.name: Chandelure
chandelure.flavor_text: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

axew.name: Axew
axew.flavor_text: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.

fraxure.name: Fraxure
fraxure.flavor_text: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.

haxorus.name: Haxorus
haxorus.flavor_text: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.

cubchoo.name: Cubchoo
cubchoo.flavor_text: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.

beartic.name: Beartic
beartic.flavor_text: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

cryogonal.name: Cryogonal
cryogonal.flavor_text: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.

shelmet.name: Shelmet
shelmet.flavor_text: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

accelgor.name: Accelgor
accelgor.flavor_text: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

stunfisk.name: Stunfisk
stunfisk.flavor_text: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

mienfoo.name: Mienfoo
mienfoo.flavor_text: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

mienshao.name: Mienshao
mienshao.flavor_text: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

druddigon.name: Druddigon
druddigon.flavor_text: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

golett.name: Golett
golett.flavor_text: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

golurk.name: Golurk
golurk.flavor_text: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

pawniard.name: Pawniard
pawniard.flavor_text: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

bisharp.name: Bisharp
bisharp.flavor_text: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

bouffalant.name: Bouffalant
bouffalant.flavor_text: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

rufflet.name: Rufflet
rufflet.flavor_text: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

braviary.name: Braviary
braviary.flavor_text: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

vullaby.name: Vullaby
vullaby.flavor_text: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

mandibuzz.name: Mandibuzz
mandibuzz.flavor_text: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

heatmor.name: Heatmor
heatmor.flavor_text: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

durant.name: Durant
durant.flavor_text: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

deino.name: Deino
deino.flavor_text: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

zweilous.name: Zweilous
zweilous.flavor_text: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

hydreigon.name: Hydreigon
hydreigon.flavor_text: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

larvesta.name: Larvesta
larvesta.flavor_text: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.

volcarona.name: Volcarona
volcarona.flavor_text: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.

cobalion.name: Cobalion
cobalion.flavor_text: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.

terrakion.name: Terrakion
terrakion.flavor_text: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.

virizion.name: Virizion
virizion.flavor_text: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.

tornadus.name: Tornadus
tornadus.flavor_text: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

thundurus.name: Thundurus
thundurus.flavor_text: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

reshiram.name: Reshiram
reshiram.flavor_text: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

zekrom.name: Zekrom
zekrom.flavor_text: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.

landorus.name: Landorus
landorus.flavor_text: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

kyurem.name: Kyurem
kyurem.flavor_text: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

keldeo.name: Keldeo
keldeo.flavor_text: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.

meloetta.name: Meloetta
meloetta.flavor_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

genesect.name: Genesect
genesect.flavor_text: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

chespin.name: Chespin
chespin.flavor_text: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

quilladin.name: Quilladin
quilladin.flavor_text: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

chesnaught.name: Chesnaught
chesnaught.flavor_text: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

fennekin.name: Fennekin
fennekin.flavor_text: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

braixen.name: Braixen
braixen.flavor_text: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

delphox.name: Delphox
delphox.flavor_text: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

froakie.name: Froakie
froakie.flavor_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

frogadier.name: Frogadier
frogadier.flavor_text: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

greninja.name: Greninja
greninja.flavor_text: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

bunnelby.name: Bunnelby
bunnelby.flavor_text: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

diggersby.name: Diggersby
diggersby.flavor_text: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

fletchling.name: Fletchling
fletchling.flavor_text: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

fletchinder.name: Fletchinder
fletchinder.flavor_text: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

talonflame.name: Talonflame
talonflame.flavor_text: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

scatterbug.name: Scatterbug
scatterbug.flavor_text: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

spewpa.name: Spewpa
spewpa.flavor_text: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

vivillon.name: Vivillon
vivillon.flavor_text: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

litleo.name: Litleo
litleo.flavor_text: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

pyroar.name: Pyroar
pyroar.flavor_text: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

flabebe.name: Flabébé
flabebe.flavor_text: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

floette.name: Floette
floette.flavor_text: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

florges.name: Florges
florges.flavor_text: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

skiddo.name: Skiddo
skiddo.flavor_text: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

gogoat.name: Gogoat
gogoat.flavor_text: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

pancham.name: Pancham
pancham.flavor_text: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

pangoro.name: Pangoro
pangoro.evolution_method: at level 32 with a Dark-type in the party
pangoro.flavor_text: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

furfrou.name: Furfrou
furfrou.flavor_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

espurr.name: Espurr
espurr.flavor_text: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

meowstic.name: Meowstic
meowstic.flavor_text: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

honedge.name: Honedge
honedge.flavor_text: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

doublade.name: Doublade
doublade.flavor_text: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

aegislash.name: Aegislash
aegislash.flavor_text: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

spritzee.name: Spritzee
spritzee.flavor_text: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

aromatisse.name: Aromatisse
aromatisse.evolution_method: when traded while holding a Sachet
aromatisse.flavor_text: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

swirlix.name: Swirlix
swirlix.flavor_text: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

slurpuff.name: Slurpuff
slurpuff.evolution_method: when traded while holding a Whipped Dream
slurpuff.flavor_text: Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

inkay.name: Inkay
inkay.flavor_text: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

malamar.name: Malamar
malamar.evolution_method: at level 30 with the console held upside down
malamar.flavor_text: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

binacle.name: Binacle
binacle.flavor_text: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.

barbaracle.name: Barbaracle
barbaracle.flavor_text: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

skrelp.name: Skrelp
skrelp.flavor_text: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

dragalge.name: Dragalge
dragalge.flavor_text: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.

clauncher.name: Clauncher
clauncher.flavor_text: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

clawitzer.name: Clawitzer
clawitzer.flavor_text: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.

helioptile.name: Helioptile
helioptile.flavor_text: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

heliolisk.name: Heliolisk
heliolisk.flavor_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

tyrunt.name: Tyrunt
tyrunt.flavor_text: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

tyrantrum.name: Tyrantrum
tyrantrum.flavor_text: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

amaura.name: Amaura
amaura.flavor_text: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

aurorus.name: Aurorus
aurorus.flavor_text: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

sylveon.name: Sylveon
sylveon.evolution_method: on level up with high friendship while knowing a Fairy-type move
sylveon.flavor_text: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

hawlucha.name: Hawlucha
hawlucha.flavor_text: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

dedenne.name: Dedenne
dedenne.flavor_text: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

carbink.name: Carbink
carbink.flavor_text: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

goomy.name: Goomy
goomy.flavor_text: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

sliggoo.name: Sliggoo
sliggoo.flavor_text: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

goodra.name: Goodra
goodra.evolution_method: at level 50 while it is raining
goodra.flavor_text: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

klefki.name: Klefki
klefki.flavor_text: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.

phantump.name: Phantump
phantump.flavor_text: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

trevenant.name: Trevenant
trevenant.flavor_text: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

pumpkaboo.name: Pumpkaboo
pumpkaboo.flavor_text: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

gourgeist.name: Gourgeist
gourgeist.flavor_text: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

bergmite.name: Bergmite
bergmite.flavor_text: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

avalugg.name: Avalugg
avalugg.flavor_text: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

noibat.name: Noibat
noibat.flavor_text: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

noivern.name: Noivern
noivern.flavor_text: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

xerneas.name: Xerneas
xerneas.flavor_text: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

yveltal.name: Yveltal
yveltal.flavor_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

zygarde.name: Zygarde
zygarde.flavor_text: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

diancie.name: Diancie
diancie.flavor_text: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

hoopa.name: Hoopa
hoopa.flavor_text: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

volcanion.name: Volcanion
volcanion.flavor_text: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

rowlet.name: Rowlet
rowlet.flavor_text: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

dartrix.name: Dartrix
dartrix.flavor_text: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

decidueye.name: Decidueye
decidueye.flavor_text: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

litten.name: Litten
litten.flavor_text: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

torracat.name: Torracat
torracat.flavor_text: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.

incineroar.name: Incineroar
incineroar.flavor_text: Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

popplio.name: Popplio
popplio.flavor_text: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

brionne.name: Brionne
brionne.flavor_text: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that’s leading them.

primarina.name: Primarina
primarina.flavor_text: For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.

pikipek.name: Pikipek
pikipek.flavor_text: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

trumbeak.name: Trumbeak
trumbeak.flavor_text: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

toucannon.name: Toucannon
toucannon.flavor_text: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

yungoos.name: Yungoos
yungoos.flavor_text: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

gumshoos.name: Gumshoos
gumshoos.flavor_text: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

grubbin.name: Grubbin
grubbin.flavor_text: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

charjabug.name: Charjabug
charjabug.flavor_text: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

vikavolt.name: Vikavolt
vikavolt.flavor_text: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

crabrawler.name: Crabrawler
crabrawler.flavor_text: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

crabominable.name: Crabominable
crabominable.flavor_text: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

oricorio.name: Oricorio
oricorio.flavor_text: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

cutiefly.name: Cutiefly
cutiefly.flavor_text: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

ribombee.name: Ribombee
ribombee.flavor_text: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

rockruff.name: Rockruff
rockruff.flavor_text: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

lycanroc.name: Lycanroc
lycanroc.flavor_text: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

wishiwashi.name: Wishiwashi
wishiwashi.flavor_text: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

mareanie.name: Mareanie
mareanie.flavor_text: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

toxapex.name: Toxapex
toxapex.flavor_text: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

mudbray.name: Mudbray
mudbray.flavor_text: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

mudsdale.name: Mudsdale
mudsdale.flavor_text: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.

dewpider.name: Dewpider
dewpider.flavor_text: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

araquanid.name: Araquanid
araquanid.flavor_text: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

fomantis.name: Fomantis
fomantis.flavor_text: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.

lurantis.name: Lurantis
lurantis.flavor_text: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

morelull.name: Morelull
morelull.flavor_text: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.

shiinotic.name: Shiinotic
shiinotic.flavor_text: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.

salandit.name: Salandit
salandit.flavor_text: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

salazzle.name: Salazzle
salazzle.flavor_text: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

stufful.name: Stufful
stufful.flavor_text: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

bewear.name: Bewear
bewear.flavor_text: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

bounsweet.name: Bounsweet
bounsweet.flavor_text: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

steenee.name: Steenee
steenee.flavor_text: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

tsareena.name: Tsareena
tsareena.evolution_method: on level up while knowing Stomp
tsareena.flavor_text: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

comfey.name: Comfey
comfey.flavor_text: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

oranguru.name: Oranguru
oranguru.flavor_text: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

passimian.name: Passimian
passimian.flavor_text: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

wimpod.name: Wimpod
wimpod.flavor_text: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.

golisopod.name: Golisopod
golisopod.flavor_text: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

sandygast.name: Sandygast
sandygast.flavor_text: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

palossand.name: Palossand
palossand.flavor_text: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

pyukumuku.name: Pyukumuku
pyukumuku.flavor_text: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

type-null.name: Type: Null
type-null.flavor_text: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

silvally.name: Silvally
silvally.evolution_method: on level up with high friendship
silvally.flavor_text: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

minior.name: Minior
minior.flavor_text: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.

komala.name: Komala
komala.flavor_text: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

turtonator.name: Turtonator
turtonator.flavor_text: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

togedemaru.name: Togedemaru
togedemaru.flavor_text: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

mimikyu.name: Mimikyu
mimikyu.flavor_text: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

bruxish.name: Bruxish
bruxish.flavor_text: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

drampa.name: Drampa
drampa.flavor_text: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

dhelmise.name: Dhelmise
dhelmise.flavor_text: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

jangmo-o.name: Jangmo-o
jangmo-o.flavor_text: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.

hakamo-o.name: Hakamo-o
hakamo-o.flavor_text: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

kommo-o.name: Kommo-o
kommo-o.flavor_text: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

tapu-koko.name: Tapu Koko
tapu-koko.flavor_text: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

tapu-lele.name: Tapu Lele
tapu-lele.flavor_text: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

tapu-bulu.name: Tapu Bulu
tapu-bulu.flavor_text: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.

tapu-fini.name: Tapu Fini
tapu-fini.flavor_text: Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.

cosmog.name: Cosmog
cosmog.flavor_text: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.

cosmoem.name: Cosmoem
cosmoem.flavor_text: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.

solgaleo.name: Solgaleo
solgaleo.flavor_text: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

lunala.name: Lunala
lunala.flavor_text: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.

nihilego.name: Nihilego
nihilego.flavor_text: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.

buzzwole.name: Buzzwole
buzzwole.flavor_text: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

pheromosa.name: Pheromosa
pheromosa.flavor_text: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

xurkitree.name: Xurkitree
xurkitree.flavor_text: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

celesteela.name: Celesteela
celesteela.flavor_text: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

kartana.name: Kartana
kartana.flavor_text: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

guzzlord.name: Guzzlord
guzzlord.flavor_text: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.

necrozma.name: Necrozma
necrozma.flavor_text: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.

magearna.name: Magearna
magearna.flavor_text: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

marshadow.name: Marshadow
marshadow.flavor_text: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.

poipole.name: Poipole
poipole.flavor_text: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.

naganadel.name: Naganadel
naganadel.evolution_method: on level up while knowing Dragon Pulse
naganadel.flavor_text: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.

stakataka.name: Stakataka
stakataka.flavor_text: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

blacephalon.name: Blacephalon
blacephalon.flavor_text: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.

zeraora.name: Zeraora
zeraora.flavor_text: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

meltan.name: Meltan
meltan.flavor_text: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.

melmetal.name: Melmetal
melmetal.evolution_method: by feeding it 400 Meltan Candies in Pokemon GO
melmetal.flavor_text: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.

grookey.name: Grookey
grookey.flavor_text: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

thwackey.name: Thwackey
thwackey.flavor_text: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.

rillaboom.name: Rillaboom
rillaboom.flavor_text: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

scorbunny.name: Scorbunny
scorbunny.flavor_text: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

raboot.name: Raboot
raboot.flavor_text: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

cinderace.name: Cinderace
cinderace.flavor_text: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

sobble.name: Sobble
sobble.flavor_text: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

drizzile.name: Drizzile
drizzile.flavor_text: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

inteleon.name: Inteleon
inteleon.flavor_text: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

skwovet.name: Skwovet
skwovet.flavor_text: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.

greedent.name: Greedent
greedent.flavor_text: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.

rookidee.name: Rookidee
rookidee.flavor_text: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

corvisquire.name: Corvisquire
corvisquire.flavor_text: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

corviknight.name: Corviknight
corviknight.flavor_text: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

blipbug.name: Blipbug
blipbug.flavor_text: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

dottler.name: Dottler
dottler.flavor_text: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

orbeetle.name: Orbeetle
orbeetle.flavor_text: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.

nickit.name: Nickit
nickit.flavor_text: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

thievul.name: Thievul
thievul.flavor_text: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

gossifleur.name: Gossifleur
gossifleur.flavor_text: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

eldegoss.name: Eldegoss
eldegoss.flavor_text: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

wooloo.name: Wooloo
wooloo.flavor_text: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

dubwool.name: Dubwool
dubwool.flavor_text: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

chewtle.name: Chewtle
chewtle.flavor_text: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

drednaw.name: Drednaw
drednaw.flavor_text: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

yamper.name: Yamper
yamper.flavor_text: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

boltund.name: Boltund
boltund.flavor_text: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

rolycoly.name: Rolycoly
rolycoly.flavor_text: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

carkol.name: Carkol
carkol.flavor_text: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

coalossal.name: Coalossal
coalossal.flavor_text: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

applin.name: Applin
applin.flavor_text: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

flapple.name: Flapple
flapple.flavor_text: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

appletun.name: Appletun
appletun.flavor_text: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

silicobra.name: Silicobra
silicobra.flavor_text: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

sandaconda.name: Sandaconda
sandaconda.flavor_text: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

cramorant.name: Cramorant
cramorant.flavor_text: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

arrokuda.name: Arrokuda
arrokuda.flavor_text: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.

barraskewda.name: Barraskewda
barraskewda.flavor_text: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.

toxel.name: Toxel
toxel.flavor_text: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

toxtricity.name: Toxtricity
toxtricity.flavor_text: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

sizzlipede.name: Sizzlipede
sizzlipede.flavor_text: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

centiskorch.name: Centiskorch
centiskorch.flavor_text: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

clobbopus.name: Clobbopus
clobbopus.flavor_text: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.

grapploct.name: Grapploct
grapploct.evolution_method: on level up while knowing Taunt
grapploct.flavor_text: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

sinistea.name: Sinistea
sinistea.flavor_text: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

polteageist.name: Polteageist
polteageist.flavor_text: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

hatenna.name: Hatenna
hatenna.flavor_text: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

hattrem.name: Hattrem
hattrem.flavor_text: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

hatterene.name: Hatterene
hatterene.flavor_text: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

impidimp.name: Impidimp
impidimp.flavor_text: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

morgrem.name: Morgrem
morgrem.flavor_text: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

grimmsnarl.name: Grimmsnarl
grimmsnarl.flavor_text: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

obstagoon.name: Obstagoon
obstagoon.evolution_method: at level 35 during the night (regional form only)
obstagoon.flavor_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

perrserker.name: Perrserker
perrserker.flavor_text: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

cursola.name: Cursola
cursola.flavor_text: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

sirfetchd.name: Sirfetch’d
sirfetchd.evolution_method: after landing three critical hits in one battle (regional form only)
